title: DDIM inversion approximates but does not exactly solve noise fixed-point equation
description: Using DDIM inversion to approximate the noise term κ approximates but is not identical to the exact solution of the fixed-point equation. Fixed points of the equation invert a single large step of DDIM, while running the ODE in reverse inverts the entire DDIM trajectory.
canonical_description: DDIM inversion provides an approximate rather than exact solution to the noise estimation fixed-point equation
